Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the primary change: source-health reporting for live queries created through DbClient, with the fix(db) prefix. The changeset adds a patch note on this behavior, and the collection-registry removal is the mechanism behind it. The title is specific and matches the changeset and linked issue `#2483`.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#2483` requires live queries created through DbClient.collection() to list their sources in health.sources and to report source failures. The cause is that getCollectionBuilder read a WeakMap filled only by createLiveQueryCollection. At head, packages/db/src/query/live/collection-registry.ts defines getCollectionBuilder(collection) as getBuilderFromConfig(collection.config). This matches the fix the issue suggests and the lookup Collection.reload() already uses. The WeakMap and registerCollectionBuilder are removed. live-query-collection.ts bridgeToCreateCollection no longer registers a builder, so the DbClient path and the createLiveQueryCollection path both resolve the builder from the config. The change also covers the other getCollectionBuilder callers named in the issue (collection-config-builder, effect). The oracle test (tests/source-health-oracle.test.ts) adds a construction dimension (direct / client). The PR reports that the client cases failed at the parent commit (397 failed) and pass after the change (922 passed). The required-history, on-demand, lazy, overlap, and request-error properties still create queries directly. The PR states this as a limit. Hydration and SSR were not covered. These are not required by the issue text.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The code changes are limited to the lookup path the issue names: collection-registry.ts (WeakMap and registerCollectionBuilder removed, getCollectionBuilder reads config) and live-query-collection.ts (bridge no longer registers a builder; cast type changes from LiveQueryCollectionUtils to TUtils). The test changes in source-health-oracle.test.ts add the DbClient construction path to the existing source-health oracle, which supports the fix. The changeset is a release note for the published fix. The unrelated failures in mutation-handler-types-oracle, oracle-replay, and shared-driver-fairness-oracle are reported with the same results at the parent commit. They are not caused by this PR's changes. Uncertainty: the summary does not show whether registerCollectionBuilder was re-exported from a public index. If it was, its removal would be a public API change that the changeset should describe. This does not affect the scope verdict.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the template. It has the Changes section explaining the bug, cause, and fix. It has an Oracle Coverage section that names the owner test file, the law, reach, RED/GREEN results, mutant check, and limits. It has the checklist and release impact sections, with the changeset box checked. The author left the 'pnpm test' checklist item unchecked, and the hydration/SSR and remaining direct-construction paths are noted as limits. The bug-fix oracle guidance asks for evidence that closes the entire declared bug class. The description lists unexercised paths (required-history, on-demand, lazy, overlap, request-error, hydration, SSR) and states the mutation gap report was not run. That is a known gap that the template says to resolve before submitting. The full packages/db run also shows 45 failing tests in unrelated oracle files, which the description reports but does not resolve. **Resolution** Clarify whether the unexercised paths (required-history, on-demand, lazy, overlap, request-error, hydration, SSR) are in the declared bug class. If they are in scope, add oracle coverage for them. If they are out of scope, state why. Run the mutation gap report or state why it does not apply. Explain the 45 failures in mutation-handler-types-oracle and oracle-replay, and the shared-driver-fairness-oracle suite error, and whether they block merge. Either run pnpm test and check the box, or explain why it was not run.
